title: IngestRequest
description:
Ingest request aligned with MCP v0.2 spec §2.2 `bicameral.ingest`.

Accepts source + snapshot + evidence + candidate fields. Source/snapshot/evidence are optional for backward compatibility — plain title+description ingest still works.

evidence_references.description:
Typed evidence references into the source snapshot.

These carry `source_kind`, optional `pointer` (kind-specific locator), and optional `metadata` for MCP session turns, tool call output, command output, transcript segments, etc. They complement the legacy span-based `evidence` field.

source_kind.description:
Typed source surface classification (e.g. `mcp_session`, `command_run`).

When provided, the resulting `Source` carries a `SourceKind` so downstream consumers can distinguish MCP sessions, command runs, tracker issues, etc. without relying on the free-form `source_type`.

DecisionLevel.description:
Decision tier classification.

Separating levels prevents collapsing product intent, architectural constraint, and implementation detail into a single undifferentiated pile.

IngestEvidenceReferenceItem.description:
A typed evidence reference item within an ingest submission.

Represents a citation into a `SourceSnapshot` with `SourceKind`-specific pointer and metadata (e.g. MCP tool call ID, command exit code).

excerpt.description: Canonical excerpt of the cited content.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for kind-specific details (e.g. MCP session turn index, command exit code, diff hunk header).

pointer.description: Kind-specific locator into the snapshot (e.g. JSON path, tool-call ID, byte offset, line range).

source_kind.description: Classification of the source surface this reference cites.

SourceKind.description:
Classification of an observed source surface.

Source kinds share governance semantics but may have different capture, refresh, indexing, and grounding implementations (CONTEXT.md). `EvidenceReference` carries a `source_kind` so downstream consumers can distinguish text spans, tracker excerpts, agent session turns, command output, PR comments, file ranges, diff hunks, and code snapshot regions.

oneOf.description: Free-form text span (meeting notes, Slack messages, documents).
Tracker issue or ticket (Jira, Linear, GitHub issue).
MCP session turn or tool call output.
Pull request comment, review, or description.
File content at a known path.
Code snapshot region backed by a `GraphSnapshot`.
